comment: Per-app rules for selection gestures. Process names are lowercase, without .exe; '*' matches any run of characters. ':name:' refers to a group. Effects: deny (never pop), terminal (never send Ctrl+C/X), allowArrowDrag (a drag may pop with the arrow cursor; only for apps whose text area shows an arrow, never a whole browser, where tab and scrollbar drags show one too). The user's excluded apps in Settings always win.

rules.name: remote-desktop
rules.comment: Keystrokes go to the remote machine, where Ctrl+C may interrupt a program

rules.name: creative-apps
rules.comment: Drags are painting, moving and selecting objects, not text

rules.name: terminal-apps
rules.comment: Terminals whose window class WinClip doesn't recognise on its own
